name: clawsec-feed
title_zh: 每天自动拉取 OpenClaw 安全公告的哨兵
tagline_zh: 上游情报每日更新，本地自动处置。不用自己盯 GitHub Release，漏洞通告到货即提醒，附修复建议。
tagline_en: Upstream intel refreshed daily, local automation ready. Stop refreshing GitHub Releases; get alerts with fix.
desc_en: Security advisory feed package for OpenClaw-related threats and vulnerabilities. The upstream feed is updated daily; local automation is handled by clawsec-suite or the operator.
why_zh: 把分散的威胁情报收口成一条本地可消费的 feed，配合 clawsec-suite 能自动跑处置动作。
why_en: Consolidates scattered threat sources into one local feed; pairs with clawsec-suite to trigger remediation, not just display.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 OpenClaw 相关威胁源，不含其他软件供应链；若你不跑 clawsec-suite，它只负责拉取和展示。
limit_en: Covers OpenClaw-related feeds only; without clawsec-suite it fetches and displays but never patches anything.
title_en: Daily OpenClaw security advisory feed watcher
